correctness.rationale: Equal coordinate-parity patterns give an odd intersection, so each odd-weight pattern contributes at most once. Separately, encoding each multiplicity x_i as the initial segment of length x_i in an m-slot block gives identity Gram matrix over F_2 and the mn bound. The size-4 and size-8 witnesses meet the parity bound and remain feasible as the cap increases. At exact cap 3 and n=4, all maximizers occupy all eight parity classes. Independent enumeration builds one selection from each class and keeps precisely pairwise-compatible choices, exhausting 128 odd vectors and giving six full families; comparing with all 24 coordinate permutations gives exactly the same six families. A different traversal count in the frozen checker is not a mathematical invariant.
